summary: Grounds one retained artifact against an exact storage registry and current document-index schema, prepares placement or human-move review plus the required index item, and stops before approval or provider writes.

dependencies.reason: Drive Filing preparation requires exact locks, private review companions, effect policy, evidence, and no-authority boundaries.
Retention, artifact form, registered destination, no-invention, and human-move meaning belong to portable Storage Context.
Document-index fields, option meaning, relationship identity, and deduplication belong to portable Docs Context.
The optional organization relationship resolves through existing portable CRM identity meaning.

requires.reason: Preparation must load one exact policy and closed registered destination set before placement judgment.
Preparation must observe exact artifact identity, kind, ownership, link, and current parents without reading content.
An externally owned artifact may produce one fingerprint-only shortcut proposal, although connected shortcut creation is unavailable.
An explicitly requested frozen snapshot may produce one fingerprint-only copy proposal; copy is never a move substitute.
Preparation must observe current document-index writable fields and exact Type and Category options.
Preparation must inspect bounded exact Link and Name candidates before proposing an index record.
A complete prepared plan may name one fingerprint-only document-index create, but this pack declares no connected compiler.
A requested organization must resolve to one exact existing CRM resource rather than a display name or invented identifier.
A requested owner=self value must resolve through the authenticated current workspace identity.

sourceRequirements.reason: Drive Filing requires one configured source for policy, exact destinations, subject mappings, categories, and the registered unclear-case inbox.
